title: Align declared assembly sequences to a declared reference
description: Direct Codex to validate DNA FASTA identity and reference provenance, run minimap2 assembly-to-reference alignment in an existing compatible environment, reload PAF evidence, and preserve record-level alignment accounting. It rejects simulated variants, direct position-wise comparison, and biological claims beyond the observed alignment.
questions: Which declared assembly sequence records align to the declared reference under a versioned minimap2 preset, and which records remain unaligned or ambiguous?
preconditions: Reference and query FASTA assets have stable identifiers, declared assemblies and digests; preset and thresholds are frozen before execution; output paths are new.
assumptions: The selected preset is biologically appropriate for the expected divergence and assembly quality.

quality_gates.description: Block absent, duplicate, empty, invalid-DNA, or undeclared assembly records.
Reload PAF and verify every coordinate, length, record identifier and alignment row against the supplied FASTA assets.
Alignment evidence alone does not call variants, haplotypes, synteny, structural variation, gene orthology or functional conservation.

version_differences.description: Preset heuristics, chaining and PAF tags are release-coupled; the template records the observed version and reloads PAF before admitting interpretation.
version_differences.required_action: Record exact preset and version and reload PAF before interpretation.

dependencies.name: python
dependencies.purpose: Validate FASTA and PAF record contracts and serialize provenance.

concept_sources: Independent clean-room replacement for assembly alignment capability identified during product capability planning.

limitations: This module does not replace variant calling, structural-variant calling, haplotype phasing, synteny inference, gene annotation, orthology inference or functional validation.

code_templates.purpose: Validate and execute a declared minimap2 assembly alignment and reload PAF evidence.

template_sections.purpose: Validate declared assembly and preset semantics before alignment.
required_logic: Inspect reference and query FASTA records, digests, assembly identifiers and expected divergence.
Refuse direct basewise comparison, guessed assemblies, simulated variants and mutable outputs.

template_sections.purpose: Run minimap2 and retain method-bounded PAF evidence.
required_logic: Detect minimap2 version, run the frozen preset, reload PAF and reconcile every record and coordinate.
Report unaligned records and retain the boundary between alignment and biological claims.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose asm5, asm10 or asm20 before examining alignment outcomes.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Do not choose a preset by desired coverage or topology.

preflight_checks: Detect minimap2 and Python versions in an existing compatible environment.
Validate FASTA identity, declared assemblies, digests, preset and output paths.
postflight_checks: Reload PAF, validate query and target coordinates and preserve aligned and unaligned record accounting.
forbidden_actions: Use only already available, project-approved scientific runtimes; do not change the user's execution environment from this module.
Do not simulate variants or haplotypes or use direct position-wise comparison after alignment failure.
Do not infer variants, synteny, structural variation, gene orthology or function from PAF alone.
